title: Handling of network rejection due to ESM cause #26

entities.name: Insufficient resources
entities.description: ESM cause value #26 indicating insufficient resources in the network.

entities.name: Back-off timer value IE
entities.description: Information Element carrying the timer value for T3396.

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator IE
entities.description: Information Element indicating re-attempt behavior, ignored in this clause.

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: Back-off timer controlling when UE can re-send session management requests after rejection.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Session management message to request PDN connectivity.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Session management message to modify bearer resources.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST
entities.description: Session management message to allocate bearer resources.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state where UE is not registered.

entities.name: Timer value neither zero nor deactivated
entities.description: Condition where Back-off timer value IE indicates a non-zero, active timer value.

entities.name: Timer value deactivated
entities.description: Condition where Back-off timer value IE indicates timer deactivation.

entities.name: Timer value zero
entities.description: Condition where Back-off timer value IE indicates zero timer value.

entities.name: No session management requests until T3396 expires
entities.description: UE behavior prohibiting sending session management requests for the same APN until T3396 expires or is stopped.

entities.name: No session management requests until specific events
entities.description: UE behavior prohibiting sending session management requests until switch-off, USIM removal, or receipt of specific network messages.

relations.description: ESM cause #26 triggers evaluation of Back-off timer value IE.
Non-zero timer value condition starts T3396 with provided value.
Non-zero timer value condition establishes prohibition of session management requests until T3396 expires.
Deactivated timer value condition establishes prohibition of session management requests until specific events occur.
Zero timer value condition stops T3396 if running.
T3396 continues running if UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Prohibition property guards sending of PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST.
Prohibition property guards sending of BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST.
Prohibition property guards sending of BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST.
